caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a human figure from the shoulders up, oriented frontally. The head is adorned with a grayish headdress featuring a fan-shaped crest at the top center, with the headdress extending around the sides of the head. The face is light brown with detailed shading, prominent cheekbones, and large, round blue eyes outlined in black. The eyebrows are arched, and the figure has a prominent mustache that curves around the mouth, also colored gray. The mouth is open, revealing visible teeth, and the lips are shaded a reddish-brown color. The ears are visible and appear to have a textured, vertical pattern. The neck is elongated, with shading suggesting musculature and possibly some mechanical or jointed structure at the base, indicated by rectangular forms. The clothing is blue-gray, covering the shoulders and upper chest, and the background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Figurehead: Turk's Head
